answer: Harbor delivery bonds stop bulk fakes crossing the ocean. Each identity locks 70 credits and ships one nectar cargo to a harbor berth, declaring its weight for arrival checks; a shortfall over 1% burns the bond. First filing 40, k-th 40+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 plus 70,000 locked. Honest agents pay 40 once, refunded after delivery. Rented berths fail: one seal cannot cover two cargoes; the duplicate burns both.
